kurz: Time works for you: doughs get stretchier, meat juicier, aromas deeper.
bild_im_kopf: Like a conversation that only sorts itself out after a pause.
was_passiert: While resting, flour and starch hydrate, tense [[glutenbildung|gluten strands]] relax and [[enzym|enzymes]] work. In meat the juice thickens a little; in dough the tension disappears.
faustregeln: Dough that springs back needs rest, not force.
Rest pasta dough and shortcrust before rolling out.
